title: ICML 2027 Call for Papers
about: Call for papers for ICML 2027, the 44th International Conference on Machine Learning, at Riocentro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, 31 July to 6 August 2027. The submission site opens 8 January 2027; abstracts are due 14 January and full papers 22 January 2027 (AoE).

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: Field 'Machine learning' → objective 'Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods'
Field 'Machine learning' → objective 'Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)'

card_alt: Card for the ICML 2027 Call for Papers from the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, abstract deadline 14 Jan 2027. The photo shows Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf Mountain in Rio de Janeiro.
